messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1798765432 - high auth failure rate for vanguard-prod (VPC private bridge). error=TLS handshake failed, downstream 403/502 spike. Pager routed to oncall.

sarah (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Paging @devon-sre.

sarah (oncall): quick question — is this limited to the vanguard tenant or broader?

devon (sre): I'm seeing repeated TLS handshake failures in auth-proxy logs: "tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate". correlating with keystore lookups.

kevin (eng-runtime): confirmed from runtime logs. client cert validation failing. Extract: "client cert CN=vanguard-app, notAfter=2026-03-15T01:12:22Z (expired)"

sarah (oncall): lia, can you confirm whether Vanguard rotated certs last night?

lia (customer-success): they reported a rotation window last night but said it was completed. I'm opening the support ticket and asking for the uploaded artifacts (chain + client cert).

devon (sre): running a local verify against their endpoint: 
```
openssl s_client -connect auth.vpc.vanguard.internal:443 -cert client.pem -key client.key
```
result: "verify error:num=10:certificate has expired"

kevin (eng-runtime): runtime also shows partial chain warnings. looks like a partial/incorrect chain was uploaded during rotation — some nodes still reject the client cert due to missing intermediate or expired cert in chain.

marco (solutions): to confirm: Vanguard is on Private (VPC) with mTLS enforced and dedicated bridge. No automatic fallback to edge auth is currently enabled for them.

sarah (oncall): impact estimate? how many requests failing and time window?\
devon (sre): about ~100% of auth attempts from tenant tv-78 (vanguard-prod) failing. Spike started at 1798765410 (≈ 6:03 UTC) and lasted until mitigation. Current window ~27m so far.

lia (customer-success): Vanguard has uploaded chain.pem to support ticket #12345 — s3 link: https://s3.internal/support/vanguard/chain.pem. I've given support + security access.

devon (sre): pulling chain, verifying checksum... ok. verifying chain with openssl shows intermediate missing previously; new chain looks complete. Proposed mitigation options:
1) Import provided chain into our keystore for tenant tv-78 and reload auth-proxy.
2) If they cannot provide, enable temporary fallback (edge-terminated auth) for that tenant while they fix rotation — requires approval.
3) Longer term: add preflight chain validation to our rotation API.

kevin (eng-runtime): I can do (1) now. Command: 
```
redwood-keystore import --tenant tv-78 --cert /tmp/vanguard/chain.pem --reload
```
Make sure the cert is verified (sha256 checksum) before import.

lia (customer-success): confirming they have given the signed chain file and the key pair. forwarding access.

ops-bot: started job keystore-import-job/ke-1798 for tenant tv-78.\
devon (sre): import running. monitoring auth-proxy logs for successful handshakes.\
devon (sre): import complete, auth-proxy reloaded. Running smoke test: 
```
curl --cacert ca.pem -H "X-Tenant: tv-78" https://auth.vpc.vanguard.internal/health
```
response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK

kevin (eng-runtime): spot checks from app traffic show successful handshakes. No more certificate expired errors for tv-78.

sarah (oncall): smoke looks good. Summary: root cause = customer's client cert expired/partial chain on rotation; impact = vanguard-prod (tenant tv-78) saw auth failures (~100%) for ~27 minutes; mitigation = imported correct chain and reloaded keystore.

lia (customer-success): drafting customer update: 
"We applied the rotated client certificate and full chain to our keystore and validated connectivity. Authentication for your prod traffic should be restored. Root cause: expired client cert + incomplete chain during rotation. Please confirm on your side and we'll keep monitoring. If you prefer, we can schedule a short validation run with you to exercise the rotation process." :white_check_mark:

kevin (eng-runtime): followups: create RN-412 to add preflight validation on keystore imports (reject partial chains + checksum validation + human confirmation). Also add an automated alert when imported cert notBefore/notAfter window is close to expiry.

marco (solutions): CS action: schedule a post-incident review with Vanguard and document recommended rotation checklist. Also ask them to use our rotation API to avoid manual S3 uploads.

sarah (oncall): no escalation to SEV-1 needed. We'll mark incident as mitigated and monitor for 1h. Oncall handoff planned: handover to night oncall @marco at 17:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Incident state change -> mitigated by devon at 1798766032.

sarah (oncall): handoff notes -> see runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-mtls-auth-failure. Key timeline: alert 1798765432, mitigation applied 1798766022, resolved 1798766032.

lia (customer-success): customer updated, they confirmed basic traffic restored. I'll leave monitoring and escalate if they report issues.

kevin (eng-runtime): filing ticket RN-412 now and will post PR for preflight checks.

devon (sre): closing on-call loop. If any residual auth errors appear, I'll reopen the thread.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT MITIGATED 1798766032 - vanguard-prod authentication restored.
